'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Norman Lansing DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Norman Lansing]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Norman Lansing]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Operational As Planned (V)]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/worlds-2014-reset-beta-event-norman-lansing-ds-eops-tto/ PC list]
